records.subject: Picking back up with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Owen,

Just checking back in -- is there something specific blocking you from getting further? Happy to help however makes sense.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Priya,

Appreciate the note. We're a bit slow to get everyone set up but it's on our list this week.

Owen

records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Owen,

Good to see Granite Collective has a real project going. Let me know if you want a second pair of eyes on how it's structured.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Granite Collective set up
records.body:
Hi Owen,

Glad to have Granite Collective on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Granite Collective* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Engaged admin: kickoff held [calendar:ca6686c0], real project created day 1, and Owen replied that team setup is "on our list this week" [email:be172cec]. But no invites sent 6 days in, key_milestone unreached, and his own note flags internal slowness; 8 days left. Responsive but passive — roughly even odds.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Thanks for the update — totally understand that getting everyone set up takes a week or two.

When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if it's a longer list.

If it's useful, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week and walk through the rollout with you so nothing stalls on your side.

Best,
Priya
